about: At age 48, Naprosyn overlaps with Atacand and the record shows no supply of a diuretic within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
At age 64, naproxen overlaps with perindopril and the record shows no supply of a diuretic within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
Indapamide covers the full naproxen course from 2025-10-29 to 2025-10-31, so there is no finding.
